approximate_exponential_correspondence.target: exp(-X/2^48) at the actual integer input X
approximate_exponential_correspondence.coefficients: The11 integer coefficients in Listing1 match the pinned C and the checked Jasmin integer Horner evaluator
approximate_exponential_correspondence.independent_error_proof: Three-cell Bernstein certificates plus finite-grid exponential comparison; coefficient accuracy is not assumed
approximate_exponential_correspondence.excluded: one-sided ceiling claim, raw ideal sigma exponent/zero-rule equivalence, and published Renyi bound

raw_acceptance_correspondence.location: Algorithm 12 and following density-ratio derivation, printed page 48 / PDF page 60
raw_acceptance_correspondence.scaling: k=2^72, sigma=2^76; CDT base sigma=sigma/k=16; y uniform integer in [0,k)
raw_acceptance_correspondence.direction_note: Uses the acceptance direction from the following ratio derivation and official specification wording; Algorithm 12 Step 4 has the opposite reject/accept wording.
raw_acceptance_correspondence.zero_rule: Algorithm 12 Step 5 tests unrounded z=0. Actual code tests rounded output; the exceptional nonzero interval is accounted for explicitly.
raw_acceptance_correspondence.excluded: Normalized accepted-output distribution, concrete SHAKE randomness, and published Renyi guarantee
